title: gamePreviewReading
responsibility: Reads GamePreview state: the AI video summary line, held arrow keys as a direction and a run's placement at its level spawn.

inputs.name: previewSummary.input
inputs.description: Whether the preview is read-only, whether live AI is configured and available, the video status, seconds left, a note, the time limit and the cost rate.

inputs.name: arrowDirection.held
inputs.description: The set of keys currently held; only the four arrow keys are read.

inputs.name: levelKey.view
inputs.description: The game view whose level and build are identified.

inputs.name: atSpawn.view
inputs.description: The view whose world spawn point and level key the run is placed by.

outputs.name: previewSummary
outputs.description: The sentence under the AI video control: the first reason it cannot run, its live or starting state, a note, or the maximum cost.

outputs.name: arrowDirection
outputs.description: A direction of -1, 0 or 1 on each axis; opposite keys cancel.

outputs.name: levelKey
outputs.description: The view id and its planning build joined by a colon.

outputs.name: atSpawn
outputs.description: The same run when the view has no world or it already belongs to this level and build; otherwise a copy placed at the spawn point.
